title: Collapse three shipping-cost branches
prompt:
shipping.py computes shipping cost three times, once per carrier, with
copy-pasted logic that already drifted apart. Unify it.

Requirements:
- quote(carrier, weight_kg, express) must exist and return the same result the
  current per-carrier functions return for every input.
- quote_us, quote_eu and quote_apac must keep their names and signatures and
  must delegate to quote.
- Unknown carriers keep the current behaviour.
- No behaviour change for any input, including invalid ones (negative weight,
  unknown carrier, None).

Only shipping.py should change.
